decision: The competitor (Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: Car 41 was released in an unsafe manner into the path of Car 23.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 41 (LIN) was released from its pit position into the path of Car 23 (ALB), which was approaching in the fast lane. The Stewards determined that this constituted an unsafe release. During the hearing, the team representative acknowledged that the release was unsafe and explained that a malfunction of the radio communication system had affected the coordination of the release procedure. The Stewards accepted this explanation and acknowledged that the communication failure was not intentional. However, the circumstances leading to the release do not alter the fact that Car 41 was released into the path of another car. The Stewards noted that reliable communication is an important element of a safe release procedure and that appropriate backup arrangements should be available in the event of a communication failure.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
